hypotheses.R1_layer11_address_subspace_is_stable: Minimum canonical cosine between Layer-11 four-address subspaces from independent covariance slices is at least 0.90.
hypotheses.R2_layer10_address_subspace_is_less_stab: Layer-10 minimum canonical cosine is at least 0.10 below Layer 11.
hypotheses.R3_k90_rank_predicts_compact_edits: For every program with operator K90 at most 2, its rank-K90 approximation has at most 10% relative prediction KL at scale 0.25 on every corpus.
hypotheses.R4_rank4_predicts_all_layer11_edits: Every Layer-11 address has at most 10% rank-four relative prediction KL at scale 0.25 on every corpus.
hypotheses.R5_top256_native_channels_predict_all_la: Every Layer-11 address has at most 10% top-256 relative prediction KL at scale 0.25 on every corpus.
hypotheses.R6_observational_boundary_features_survi: At least five addresses with recurrent current-newline features change in the predicted direction in at least 75% of substitutions on every corpus.
hypotheses.R7_rank_frontier_is_scale_stable: For every Layer-11 address, the selected rank's median relative error at scale 1.0 is at most twice its scale-0.25 error.
hypotheses.R8_layer11_compactness_is_slice_stable: All four Layer-11 addresses have operator K90 at most 4 on both covariance slices.
